description: Financial models as plain text: YAML models calculated by one Rust engine, as a command line, an MCP server for AI agents, and a browser app.
rules: Start from docs/guide/ and skills/forge-modelling/SKILL.md; the other pages are reference.
Change a model with `forge edit`, then run `forge calculate` and `forge validate`; the exit status of `forge validate` is the verdict.
Forge gives the arithmetic; write the YAML and let the command calculate, never compute a result by hand.
